description: This Java class 'ClientChargeDataValidator' provides data validation logic for client charge operations in the Fineract project. It includes methods to validate addition, update, and payment of charges with JSON input, leveraging helper classes for JSON parsing and validation error handling.

classes.name: ClientChargeDataValidator
classes.description: A component responsible for validating JSON data for client charge operations such as adding, updating, and paying charges in the Fineract system.

methods.name: validateAdd
methods.description: Validates JSON input for adding a new client charge, ensuring amount and due date are provided and valid.

methods.name: validateUpdate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for updating an existing client charge, validating optional fields like amount and due date if they are present.

methods.name: validatePayCharge
methods.description: Validates JSON input for paying a client charge, ensuring amount and transaction date are present and valid.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws validation exception if any validation errors have been accumulated.
